in_hebrew.name: גרשד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: One who dwells as a foreigner or sojourner, an outsider, a stranger.

in_greek.name: Γερραλδος
in_greek.long_meaning: Soldier of Ger, or ruler of the Ger (foreigners) or Gerar (city of the Gerzites)

in_latin.name: Gerraldus
in_latin.long_meaning: Ger, ruler or leader, and hald, strong or ruling, so Gerald, ruler with the strength of a Ger
